description.value: This cross-sectional study compared four observational cohorts: cannabis-dependent individuals who did not smoke tobacco, cannabis-dependent individuals who smoked tobacco, cannabis-naïve nicotine-dependent individuals who smoked tobacco, and cannabis- and tobacco-naïve healthy controls.
